# Benchmark Baseline

The promoted result of each benchmark.

- **Run:** `local_latency v1 @ c82a001 2026-10-17 · remote_latency v1 @ c82a001 2026-10-18+dirty · peak_mem v1 @ c82a001 2026-10-17`
- **Repeat:** local 3, remote 3

## PEAK MEMORY (local GPU)

- **Setup:** local, bfloat16, autocast, swept=prompt_length, repeat=3, footprint=weights + 500.0MiB padding bias
- **Cells:** largest `prompt_length` whose peak stays within N% of the model footprint (weights + padding bias) (`>=` hit the length cap, `<` already over at the smallest length)

### activation_patching

![activation_patching — peak memory](data:image/png;base64,)

| Model | Params | Weights | Footprint | 10% | 25% | 50% |
|-------|--------|--------:|----------:|----:|----:|----:|
| google/gemma-3-1b-pt | (default) | 1.86GiB | 2.35GiB | <2 | 20 | 66 |
| meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B | (default) | 14.96GiB | 15.45GiB | 123 | 307 | 616 |
| openai-community/gpt2 | (default) | 237.4MiB | 737.4MiB | 36 | 108 | 218 |

### j_lens

![j_lens — peak memory](data:image/png;base64,)

| Model | Params | Weights | Footprint | 10% | 25% | 50% |
|-------|--------|--------:|----------:|----:|----:|----:|
| google/gemma-3-1b-pt | top_k=5, include_entropy=True | 1.86GiB | 2.35GiB | 17 | 44 | 88 |
| meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B | top_k=5, include_entropy=True | 14.96GiB | 15.45GiB | 188 | 476 | 956 |
| openai-community/gpt2 | top_k=5, include_entropy=True | 237.4MiB | 737.4MiB | 55 | 141 | 283 |
